parsed.explanation: Worst documented features sit at tier 2: since the March 2022 exception regime, trans women have been arbitrarily captured in mass raids and held in the ordinary prison system with no gender-identity accommodation, plus documented abuse (forced hair-shaving, punishment drills, denied HIV care). Police, soldiers and prison guards are documented targeting men for effeminate behaviour/dress with searches, theft, sexual assault and violence; police have shown blatant refusal to cooperate in LGBT death investigations. About 500 reported hate crimes (1998-2015, many unreported), gang extortion, and a 2013 study finding 85% accepted attacking a trans person indicate societal hostility with thin effective recourse — corroborated by 2020-21 international findings of failure to protect. Positives are real but partial: hate-crime law covering gender identity, 30-60 year bias-killing penalty, a 2020 conviction of three officers (20 years each), 2009 health non-discrimination guidelines, and judicial release in one raid case. No presentation offence or death penalty is documented. Net: state-tolerated targeting with uneven remedy.
